test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing the north but not necessarily in the same order. Three persons are sitting between D and F. G is sitting to the immediate left of D. Only one person is sitting between E and B. E is not sitting at any of the extreme ends. More than three persons are sitting between H and A. A is sitting to the left of H. Either H or A is sitting at one of the ends. Neither D nor F is sitting at any of the extreme ends. E and B are not the immediate neighbours of G and D. E is sitting to the right of B.

How many persons are sitting between H and C?
solution:
Given: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting in a row facing the north but not necessarily in the same order.

According to the given statements, we have:

1) Three persons are sitting between D and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f126c9f3f2b7f85dc043b72bc4a24f63ad1a6923ae37f6de10747f6d407693a.png] 

2) G is sitting to the immediate left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58eac8956fa43c78c2f133d0b7cb7c2a20c72e578f35fb2b129dab86bf3c3d5d.png] 

3) Neither D nor F is sitting at any of the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b35199ab4169e68e82cf35a3b3ebf2adde32ecd0bc5ceed7e271c2bfc9c8777a.png] 

4) Only one person is sitting between E and B. E is sitting to the right of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75bc8cce705c09ae861185d20a756ac4e444a8956e2ff248320677aa8824d2df.png] 

5) E is not sitting at any of the extreme ends. E and B are not the immediate neighbors of G and D. So, Case 2 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9f0c9e497e4152a4db82815e88b81fa034ae6d75f2ff095b31ebb9019695d66.png] 

6) More than three persons are sitting between H and A. Either H or A is sitting at one of the ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a024031333fd0a9dfef0483e5de8e57e2a81d82445ba7b1650cb06ee2212711.png] 

7) A is sitting to the left of H. So, Case 1b is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf1aa7083b742557fdd9a967c8d2d06e05887aa67fd0ffbcfbfdb60044188855.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec50c44311f2f317c31da440217e6562acf0b09bd063fd6c99cec01de512ee03.png] 

Thus, there are '**three**' persons sitting between H and C.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
